source.title: Erratum to: A common approach to three open problems in number theory

trace.notes: Resolved the zbMATH record to the source PDF for DOI 10.47443/dml.2023.049e. The source is a one-page erratum on p. 103 with no sections containing explicit open problems.

Scanned the full visible source text on p. 103. No explicit or implicit open research questions are stated in the erratum; the page only corrects a sentence in the referenced article and cites the original work.

Accepted list is empty because the chosen primary source does not itself contain any problem statements. The title and reference to the original article are insufficient to extract questions from this run without switching to a different work.
